title: fetch.py drops <aside> sidebars that hold page content, so facts from them are never anchored
goal: The HTML-to-text reduction in _tools/fetch.py keeps the text of a content sidebar (an <aside> inside the article body, such as the sre.google book's data-type=sidebar boxes) while still skipping navigation asides, so provider.py read and factdiff.py anchor find a quote that sits in such a sidebar.
notes: 2026-10-15 ST-bke44brb: platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory (S-ovnqfusm) holds its Beta banner (header agent-memory-2026-07-22) in an <aside> and its 'Don't combine agent-memory-2026-07-22 with managed-agents-2026-04-01' note in a callout; both are missing from the text factdiff.py and provider.py read extract, so the fact at agents/agent-memory-services.md (the beta-header fact) prints 'quote not held' although the raw HTML holds the sentence.
